captured_cases.expected_outcome: A controlled partial real roadmap refuses every result-bearing route.
A real scorecard produces units times seven cells and exposes partial status.

atomic_step.outcome: Every opened unit is crossed with seven fixed lenses and no result route leaks before all cells are judged.
atomic_step.practical_value: A partial critique is visibly partial and cannot be mistaken for a complete assessment.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: Both real pages produce exact matrices and all result routes refuse the controlled partial state.

composition.assembly_contract: Use the selected matrix construction and route gate unchanged.

final_validation.failure_criterion: Any matrix is malformed or any result route leaks.
final_validation.operator_path: open each frozen real archive, create controlled partial state, and invoke status/cell/report/document
final_validation.success_criterion: Both cases show exact partial matrices and all three result routes refuse.

approaches.hypothesis: Protecting only assembled outputs is enough because individual cells are not final reports.
approaches.implementation: Gate report and document, but return any addressed judged cell.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Less restrictive inspection, but a partial run can leak a completed-looking result.

approaches.hypothesis: Every result-bearing route must share one completeness gate to make partial work unmistakable.
approaches.implementation: Gate cell, report, and document through one missing-cell check; keep status diagnostic-only.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Operators cannot inspect one completed cell until the whole matrix closes.

mini_probes.goal: Close every result-bearing route over the same exact unit-by-lens matrix.
mini_probes.practical_value: A partial critique is visibly partial and cannot be mistaken for a complete assessment.

proof.failure_criterion: Wrong dimensions, completed status, or any result-bearing route returns while a cell is unjudged.
proof.success_criterion: Exact matrix shape, partial status, and three actionable route refusals on both real pages.

winner_output.description: The exact fixed-lens matrix and shared result-route gate.

mini_probes.work_type_reason: Matrix enumeration and route admission are deterministic state boundaries.
